---
title: "Reference"
---

This page lists the options of My project.
Replace the table with the options of your project.

## Options

| Option | Default | Use |
|--------|---------|-----|
| `title` | `"My project"` | The name of the site. |
| `description` | none | The short text for search engines. |
| `repo-url` | none | The address of the repository. |

## Commands

| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `quarto preview` | Show the site and update it when a file changes. |
| `quarto render` | Build the site in the `_site` folder. |
